import os
import scanpy as sc
os.makedirs('distortions/notebooks/pbmc/data/data', exist_ok=True)
try:
    adata = sc.datasets.pbmc3k()
except Exception as e:
    print('DOWNLOAD_ERROR', e)
    raise
adata.write('distortions/notebooks/pbmc/data/data/pbmc3k_processed.h5ad')
sc.pp.pca(adata, n_comps=50)
sc.pp.neighbors(adata, n_neighbors=10, n_pcs=50)
sc.tl.umap(adata, init_pos='spectral')
sc.tl.leiden(adata, resolution=0.5, n_iterations=2, flavor='igraph', directed=False)
labels = adata.obs['leiden']
if hasattr(labels, 'cat'):
    print(len(labels.cat.categories))
else:
    print(len(set(labels)))
PY")
